title: Volume of a Parallelepiped via Scalar Triple Product
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Find the volume of the parallelepiped determined by u = <1, 2, 3>, v = <-1, 1, 2>, and w = <2, 1, 4>.

steps.title: Set Up 3x3 Determinant
steps.explanation: Write the components of the three vectors as rows of a 3x3 matrix.

steps.title: Evaluate Determinant
steps.explanation: Expand across the first row and sum terms.

steps.title: Take Absolute Value
steps.explanation: Volume is the magnitude of the scalar triple product.
